name: memory_remember
description: Store a memory with optional cognitive metadata. Use 'tier' to choose where it goes: WORKING (ephemeral scratchpad), EPISODIC (personal experiences with time context), SEMANTIC (facts and knowledge, default), PROCEDURAL (skills, patterns, how-to). Set 'interest', 'challenge', 'urgency' (0.0-1.0) for importance tuning. Set 'valence' for emotional memories (-128=very negative, +127=very positive). Set 'arousal' for intensity (0=calm, 255=extreme). Tags help with contextual recall (e.g., 'preferences', 'architecture'). Use 'workspace_id' + 'agent_id' to store in a shared workspace.

id.description: Unique identifier for this memory. If omitted, a TSID is auto-generated.

text.description: The fact, experience, or knowledge to remember.

tags.description: Comma-separated contextual tags for Bloom filter encoding.

source.description: Memory source: USER_STATED, OBSERVED, INFERRED, PROCEDURAL.

tier.description: Memory tier: WORKING (ephemeral), EPISODIC (experiences), SEMANTIC (facts, default), PROCEDURAL (skills/patterns).

interest.description: ICNU: how relevant to current task (0.0-1.0). High for directly actionable info.

challenge.description: ICNU: how complex or difficult the problem is (0.0-1.0). High for novel technical problems.

urgency.description: ICNU: how time-critical this information is (0.0-1.0). High for deadlines, incidents.

valence.description: Emotional valence: -128 (extremely negative) to +127 (extremely positive). 0 = neutral. Use for emotionally significant memories.

arousal.description: Emotional intensity: 0 (calm) to 255 (extreme). 0 = neutral. Auto-derived from |valence| if not set.

namespace.description: Memory namespace to store into. Isolates agent/user memory spaces. Leave empty for default namespace.

metadata.description: JSON object with multimodal metadata. Keys: 'modality' (TEXT/IMAGE/AUDIO/VIDEO), 'source_uri' (asset path/URL), plus any custom key-value pairs. Example: {"modality":"IMAGE","source_uri":"file:///photo.jpg"}

workspace_id.description: Shared workspace ID for multi-agent storage. When set, the memory is stored in the workspace's shared pool. Requires 'agent_id' for RBAC. Leave empty for personal memory.

agent_id.description: Agent identity for workspace RBAC. Required when 'workspace_id' is set. The agent must have write access to the workspace.
